sustained.workload: Display and capture workers, physical micro lite Port5 note-on/off each second. Diagnostic package build and short independent console/native startup also occurred during this run; this is a finite observed workload, not indefinite/maximum-load qualification.

limitations: Supported Windows endpoint/rate and MOTU44100Hz512-frame profile only; five-minute qualification does not prove indefinite or arbitrary CPU-load continuity.
Transport output target is16384 frames (371.52ms), separately displayed from driver latency; this trades latency for scheduling headroom.
2048 input frames discarded during the sustained playback workload; zero-loss recording is not inferred.
Measured physical bridge arrival upper bounds exclude MAME/MIDI transport and include2048-frame input block completion; not pure converter or full instrument roundtrip latency.
Driver-level loss measurement is ASIO-reported status flags, not proof of unreported physical-driver loss.
Production ADC alternate clocks and hardware register/meter fidelity remain open.

A first windowed package launch failed without a captured exception; instrumented windowed startup and packaged browser then passed. Desktop/repeated-start acceptance is recorded separately; no clean-machine release claim.
